cues: The r squared explains why clouds float.
Their droplets are so tiny that their terminal velocity is almost zero, while big raindrops fall fast.
Millikan used this law to find the size of his oil drops, and so the charge of the electron.
And timing a ball bearing falling through a liquid is how we measure its viscosity.
